notablePrerequisites: Accomplished Alchemist does not have summoning sickness. You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Accomplished Alchemist.
description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
